regime_context: The US theme detector shows Memory & Storage as the fading momentum leader (durability 0.44, zero breadth). theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory & Storage is the fading momentum leader with very low durability (0.44), zero breadth, and a fading value state, suggesting fragile leadership. The absolute trend gate is still passed (eligible), but structural staying power is lacking. Avoid until durability and breadth improve.
theses.dissent: Fading leadership can reverse abruptly on a positive catalyst; low crowding indicates no immediate reflexivity risk.
